name: THE RITUALS — Engines & Interactions
objective: Build all 13 divination engine 3D artifacts with physics interactions, backend API endpoints, Field Journal persistence, and the Cartographer meta-engine.

sprints.focus: Tier 1 Ancient Instruments (I-Ching, Vimshottari, Tarot, Runes, Numerology)

tasks.title: Build I-Ching Oracle 3D scene: stone dish on pedestal with Dark Stone material
tasks.deliverable: Create the I-Ching Oracle 3D scene consisting of a stone dish on a pedestal using Dark Stone material. The dish serves as the target for coin tosses. Place within the East Wing spatial coordinate system.
tasks.acceptance: Stone dish mesh renders on pedestal with Dark Stone PBR material; Dish interior has concave collision shape for coin containment; Positioned within East Wing spatial coordinate system

tasks.title: Create 3 I-Ching coin RigidBodies: Dynamic, mass 0.3, restitution 0.6, Gold material
tasks.deliverable: Create three I-Ching coin rigid bodies using Rapier physics. Each coin is Dynamic type with mass 0.3 and restitution 0.6. Apply Gold PBR material. Coins must have two distinct faces for yin/yang determination.
tasks.acceptance: 3 coin RigidBodies with mass 0.3 and restitution 0.6; Gold material applied to all coins; Coins behave physically (bounce, settle) in the dish

tasks.title: Implement I-Ching coin toss physics: GRASP coins, THROW into dish, settle detection
tasks.deliverable: Implement coin toss interaction using GRASP gesture to pick up coins and THROW gesture to toss them into the dish. Detect when all 3 coins have settled (velocity below threshold for 500ms) to read the result.
tasks.acceptance: GRASP gesture picks up coins from rest position; THROW gesture tosses coins with physics-based trajectory into dish; Settle detection triggers reading after all coins reach sub-threshold velocity for 500ms

tasks.title: Build I-Ching hexagram builder: 6 throws to lines (solid/broken) to hexagram number
tasks.deliverable: Build the hexagram construction logic. Each of 6 throws produces a line (solid Yang or broken Yin) based on coin face combination. Stack lines bottom-to-top to form a hexagram. Map the 6-line binary to one of 64 hexagram numbers, including changing line detection.
tasks.acceptance: 6 sequential throws produce 6 lines (solid or broken); Lines stack bottom-to-top following traditional I-Ching order; Correct mapping to 1 of 64 hexagram numbers; Changing lines detected from specific coin combinations

tasks.title: Create FastAPI I-Ching interpretation endpoint: POST /api/engines/i-ching
tasks.deliverable: Create FastAPI endpoint that accepts a hexagram number and changing lines, returns the hexagram name, judgment text, image text, and line interpretations. Include transformed hexagram if changing lines exist.
tasks.acceptance: POST /api/engines/i-ching accepts hexagram_number and changing_lines; Returns hexagram name, judgment, image, and line texts; Returns transformed hexagram when changing lines present; Response time under 200ms

tasks.title: Build I-Ching 3D text rendering: hexagram name + interpretation floating above dish
tasks.deliverable: Render the I-Ching interpretation as 3D billboard text floating above the stone dish. Display hexagram name prominently, followed by interpretation text with typewriter reveal effect. Text faces the user camera.
tasks.acceptance: Hexagram name renders as billboard text above dish; Interpretation text appears with typewriter effect; Text always faces active camera; Text fades at distance > 15 units

tasks.title: Implement I-Ching coin face materials (inscribed Chinese characters vs plain gold)
tasks.deliverable: Create distinct materials for each coin face. One side has inscribed Chinese characters (Yang/heads), the other is plain gold (Yin/tails). The face-up determination after settling drives the line type.
tasks.acceptance: Each coin has two visually distinct faces; Character side clearly distinguishable from plain gold side; Face-up detection works correctly after coin settles

tasks.title: Build I-Ching line visualization: Gold bars (Yang) / gaps (Yin) stacking above dish
tasks.deliverable: Visualize each hexagram line as a 3D element stacking above the dish. Yang lines are solid Gold bars, Yin lines are broken bars with a gap. Lines appear one at a time after each throw, building the hexagram visually.
tasks.acceptance: Yang lines render as solid Gold bars; Yin lines render as two short bars with central gap; Lines stack bottom-to-top with each successive throw; Smooth appearance animation for each new line

tasks.title: Implement I-Ching changing line display: primary + transformed hexagram side by side
tasks.deliverable: When changing lines are present, display both the primary hexagram and the transformed hexagram side by side above the dish. Changing lines glow with a pulsing effect to highlight them. An arrow or transition visual connects the two hexagrams.
tasks.acceptance: Primary and transformed hexagrams display side by side; Changing lines have pulsing glow effect; Visual transition element connects the two hexagrams; Only appears when changing lines are detected

tasks.title: Create Vimshottari Clock 3D artifact: concentric golden rings on dark pedestal
tasks.deliverable: Build the Vimshottari Dasha Clock as concentric golden rings (Maha, Antar, Pratyantar Dasha levels) mounted on a dark pedestal. Each ring has inscribed planetary period markers. The artifact evokes an astronomical instrument.
tasks.acceptance: Three concentric golden rings at different radii and heights; Dark pedestal base with appropriate PBR material; Planetary period markers inscribed on each ring; Positioned within East Wing spatial coordinate system

tasks.title: Build Vimshottari ring rotation interaction: ORBIT gesture rotates selected ring
tasks.deliverable: Implement ring rotation interaction using a circular ORBIT gesture. When user hovers a ring, it highlights. The ORBIT gesture then rotates the selected ring to navigate between Dasha periods. Rotation has momentum and damping.
tasks.acceptance: Hover highlights the targeted ring; ORBIT gesture rotates the selected ring smoothly; Rotation has momentum with damping (settles naturally); Ring snaps to nearest Dasha period on settle

tasks.title: Create FastAPI Vimshottari Dasha calculation endpoint: POST /api/engines/vimshottari
tasks.deliverable: Create FastAPI endpoint that accepts birth data (date, time, moon longitude) and calculates the full Vimshottari Dasha timeline. Returns Maha, Antar, and Pratyantar Dasha periods with start/end dates and planetary rulers.
tasks.acceptance: POST /api/engines/vimshottari accepts birth date, time, and moon longitude; Returns complete Maha Dasha sequence with dates; Returns Antar and Pratyantar sub-periods; Current active period highlighted in response

tasks.title: Build Tarot Spiral: 78 holographic card orbital ring floating at chest height
tasks.deliverable: Create a spiral orbital ring of 78 Tarot cards floating at chest height. Cards are arranged in a gentle spiral with holographic sheen (SparkJS splat-based iridescence). The spiral slowly rotates when idle.
tasks.acceptance: 78 card planes arranged in spiral orbital formation; Spiral floats at approximate chest height (1.3m); Holographic iridescent sheen via SparkJS gaussian splats; Idle rotation at 1 revolution per 120 seconds

tasks.title: Implement Tarot SparkJS veil mechanic: semi-transparent splat curtain over undrawn cards
tasks.deliverable: Create a semi-transparent veil using SparkJS gaussian splats that covers the card spiral. The veil acts as a mystical barrier. Cards behind the veil are partially obscured. The veil parts locally when user hand approaches with sufficient coherence.
tasks.acceptance: SparkJS splat veil renders as semi-transparent curtain over cards; Cards behind veil are visually obscured but faintly visible; Veil parts locally around user hand position; Veil re-forms when hand withdraws

tasks.title: Build Tarot card draw: gesture reaches through veil, coherence > 60 required to grasp
tasks.deliverable: Implement the card draw mechanic. User reaches through the veil using GRASP gesture. Coherence score must exceed 60% for the grasp to succeed. On successful grasp, the selected card detaches from the spiral and follows the hand. Card can be placed in spread positions.
tasks.acceptance: GRASP gesture through veil selects nearest card; Coherence threshold of 60% enforced for successful draw; Selected card detaches and follows hand movement; Failed draw (low coherence) shows visual rejection feedback

tasks.title: Create FastAPI Tarot interpretation endpoint: POST /api/engines/tarot
tasks.deliverable: Create FastAPI endpoint that accepts drawn card IDs, positions in spread, and orientation (upright/reversed). Returns per-card interpretation, positional meaning, and overall spread narrative synthesis.
tasks.acceptance: POST /api/engines/tarot accepts card_ids, positions, and orientations; Returns per-card interpretation with positional context; Returns overall spread narrative synthesis; Supports single, three-card, and Celtic Cross spreads

tasks.title: Implement Tarot card face textures: 78 cards as texture atlas (efficient GPU upload)
tasks.deliverable: Create a texture atlas containing all 78 Tarot card faces (22 Major Arcana + 56 Minor Arcana). Use UV offset/scale per card to sample from the atlas. Single texture bind for all cards for GPU efficiency. Card backs use a shared ornate design.
tasks.acceptance: Single texture atlas contains all 78 card faces; UV offset/scale correctly maps each card to its atlas region; Single GPU texture bind serves all cards; Card back design is shared and ornate

tasks.title: Build Tarot spread layout system: single card, three-card, Celtic Cross positions
tasks.deliverable: Build the spread layout system with predefined 3D positions for different spread types. Single card: centered in front. Three-card: past/present/future in a row. Celtic Cross: 10 positions in traditional layout. Cards animate to their positions when placed.
tasks.acceptance: Single card spread places card centered in front of user; Three-card spread arranges past/present/future in a horizontal row; Celtic Cross spread positions 10 cards in traditional layout; Cards animate smoothly to target positions on placement

tasks.title: Create Rune Stones: leather pouch mesh + 24 Elder Futhark stone RigidBodies
tasks.deliverable: Create the Rune Stones artifact consisting of a leather pouch mesh and 24 Elder Futhark rune stone rigid bodies. The pouch is a soft-body-like mesh that can be opened. Stones rest inside and can be drawn out.
tasks.acceptance: Leather pouch mesh with PBR leather material; 24 rune stone RigidBodies contained within pouch; Pouch opens to reveal stones on interaction; Stones are individually graspable

tasks.title: Implement Rune stone irregular pebble geometry (24 unique meshes with carved glyphs)
tasks.deliverable: Create 24 unique irregular pebble-shaped meshes, each with a carved Elder Futhark glyph on one face. Glyphs are geometry-carved (not just texture) for depth. Each stone has a slightly different shape and size for organic feel.
tasks.acceptance: 24 unique pebble meshes with organic irregular shapes; Each stone has a distinct Elder Futhark glyph carved into geometry; Glyphs have visible depth (not flat textures); Stone material has natural stone PBR properties

tasks.title: Build Rune spatial casting: THROW stones from pouch, read based on landing positions/orientations
tasks.deliverable: Implement the rune casting mechanic. User draws stones from pouch with GRASP and THROWs them onto a casting cloth. Reading is determined by which stones land face-up (glyph visible), their positions relative to each other, and proximity to center.
tasks.acceptance: GRASP draws stones from open pouch; THROW casts stones onto casting surface; Face-up/face-down detection based on glyph normal direction; Position and proximity analysis determines reading context

tasks.title: Create FastAPI Rune interpretation endpoint: POST /api/engines/runes
tasks.deliverable: Create FastAPI endpoint that accepts cast rune data (rune IDs, face-up/down, positions, orientations). Returns individual rune meanings, positional context (center vs periphery), and combined narrative interpretation.
tasks.acceptance: POST /api/engines/runes accepts rune_ids, orientations, and positions; Returns individual rune meanings with facing context; Returns positional interpretation (center = primary, periphery = supporting); Returns combined narrative synthesis

tasks.title: Build Numerology Matrix: input form (name + birthdate) to crystalline number grid
tasks.deliverable: Build the Numerology Matrix artifact. Starts as a minimal 3D input form where user provides name and birthdate. On submission, the form transforms into a crystalline grid of numbers showing Life Path, Expression, Soul Urge, and other core numbers.
tasks.acceptance: 3D input form accepts name and birthdate; Form transforms into crystalline number grid on submission; Grid displays Life Path, Expression, Soul Urge, and Personality numbers; Crystalline material with transparency and refraction

tasks.title: Implement Numerology cascading number animation (waterfall, 50ms stagger per row)
tasks.deliverable: Implement the cascading waterfall animation for the numerology grid. Numbers appear row by row with 50ms stagger between each row. Each number fades in and scales up from zero. The effect creates a digital rain / Matrix-like waterfall aesthetic.
tasks.acceptance: Numbers cascade row-by-row with 50ms stagger; Each number fades in and scales from 0 to full size; Animation creates waterfall visual effect; Total animation duration under 3 seconds for full grid

tasks.title: Build Numerology radial mandala: grid transforms to radial layout with Life Path at center
tasks.deliverable: After the grid appears, implement a transformation to a radial mandala layout. The Life Path number moves to the center, with other numbers orbiting in concentric rings by importance. The transition is animated over 2 seconds with easing.
tasks.acceptance: Grid transforms to radial mandala layout on trigger; Life Path number positioned at center with emphasis; Other numbers orbit in concentric rings by significance; Smooth 2-second animated transition with easing

tasks.title: Create FastAPI Numerology calculation endpoint: POST /api/engines/numerology
tasks.deliverable: Create FastAPI endpoint that accepts name and birthdate, calculates all core numerology numbers (Life Path, Expression, Soul Urge, Personality, Birthday, Maturity), and returns interpretations for each.
tasks.acceptance: POST /api/engines/numerology accepts name and birthdate; Calculates Life Path, Expression, Soul Urge, Personality numbers; Calculates Birthday and Maturity numbers; Returns interpretive text for each number

tasks.title: Implement Tier 1 spatial placement: all 5 engines at radius 5 units from East Wing center (50,0,0)
tasks.deliverable: Position all 5 Tier 1 engines (I-Ching, Vimshottari, Tarot, Runes, Numerology) at radius 5 units from the East Wing center point (50,0,0). Engines are evenly spaced around the circle at 72-degree intervals. Each faces outward from center.
tasks.acceptance: All 5 Tier 1 engines positioned at radius 5 from (50,0,0); 72-degree spacing between engines; Each engine faces outward from circle center; No z-fighting or overlap between engine artifacts

tasks.title: Build inter-engine filament connections: golden thread geometry between consulted engines
tasks.deliverable: Create golden thread geometry (thin tube or line with glow) that connects engines the user has consulted. Threads appear after second engine consultation and grow with each additional engine. Thread brightness indicates recency of consultation.
tasks.acceptance: Golden thread geometry connects consulted engines; Threads appear after second engine is consulted; Thread brightness correlates with consultation recency; Thread geometry uses efficient tube or line rendering

tasks.title: Create engine interaction state manager: hovered/engaged/reading_in_progress per engine
tasks.deliverable: Build a state manager (Zustand store) tracking each engine's interaction state: idle, hovered, engaged (actively being used), reading_in_progress (API call pending), reading_complete. Ensures only one engine can be engaged at a time.
tasks.acceptance: Zustand store tracks state per engine: idle/hovered/engaged/reading_in_progress/reading_complete; Only one engine can be in engaged state at a time; State transitions trigger appropriate visual/audio feedback; State accessible from any component via hook

tasks.title: Build shared 3D text rendering system: billboard, typewriter effect at 40ms/char, fade at 15u
tasks.deliverable: Create a reusable 3D text rendering system used by all engines. Text renders as camera-facing billboard. Characters appear with typewriter effect at 40ms per character. Text fades to transparent beyond 15 units distance. Supports multi-line with word wrapping.
tasks.acceptance: Billboard text always faces active camera; Typewriter effect reveals characters at 40ms intervals; Text fades to transparent beyond 15 units; Supports multi-line with configurable word wrapping; Reusable component API for all 13 engines

tasks.title: Implement engine hover expansion: scale 1.1x on raycast, 300ms tween
tasks.deliverable: When the user's hand ray or gaze ray intersects an engine artifact, scale it to 1.1x over 300ms with ease-out tween. Return to 1.0x on ray exit. The expansion provides tactile feedback that the engine is interactive.
tasks.acceptance: Engine scales to 1.1x when raycast intersects; 300ms ease-out tween for scale up; Returns to 1.0x on ray exit with matching tween; Only triggers for idle/hovered states (not during active use)

tasks.title: Create loading state particle burst for engine API calls (anticipation effect)
tasks.deliverable: When an engine transitions to reading_in_progress state (API call fired), emit a burst of luminous particles from the artifact. Particles spiral outward and upward, creating anticipation. Particles persist until API response arrives.
tasks.acceptance: Particle burst emits when reading_in_progress state enters; Particles spiral outward and upward from artifact center; Particles persist during API call duration; Particles dissipate on API response arrival

tasks.title: Build engine reading loading animation (artifact glows and emits particles during API wait)
tasks.deliverable: During reading_in_progress, the engine artifact itself glows with increasing intensity (emissive ramp from 0.2 to 0.8 over 3 seconds, then pulse). Combined with the particle burst, this creates a cohesive loading state visual.
tasks.acceptance: Artifact emissive ramps from 0.2 to 0.8 over 3 seconds; Emissive pulses between 0.6 and 0.8 after initial ramp; Glow ceases on API response and transitions to reading_complete; Works in conjunction with particle burst from P3-S1-32

sprints.focus: Tier 2 Biological Mirrors + Tier 3 Synthesis Start

tasks.title: Build Biorhythm Compass: translucent pulsing sphere with 3 sine wave ribbons
tasks.deliverable: Create the Biorhythm Compass artifact as a translucent pulsing sphere with three interwoven sine wave ribbons (Physical=red, Emotional=blue, Intellectual=green). Sphere pulses gently at resting heart rate. SparkJS splats create the translucent volume.
tasks.acceptance: Translucent sphere renders with SparkJS gaussian splats; Three sine wave ribbons visible within sphere (red, blue, green); Sphere pulses gently at approximately 60 BPM default; Ribbons animate their sine wave phase continuously

tasks.title: Implement Biorhythm PIP sync: Physical/Emotional/Intellectual waves from live bio-data
tasks.deliverable: Connect the Biorhythm Compass to the PIP bio-data pipeline. Physical wave amplitude modulated by HRV, Emotional by facial affect valence, Intellectual by blink rate patterns. Fallback to birthdate-calculated biorhythms when PIP unavailable.
tasks.acceptance: Physical wave amplitude modulated by HRV data from PIP; Emotional wave modulated by facial affect valence; Intellectual wave modulated by blink rate patterns; Graceful fallback to birthdate-calculated biorhythms without PIP

tasks.title: Build Biorhythm scrub interaction: click-drag rim for date navigation, 30-day projection
tasks.deliverable: Add an interactive rim to the Biorhythm sphere that can be click-dragged to scrub through time. Dragging right moves forward in time, left moves backward. Shows a 30-day projection of biorhythm cycles. Current date marked with a bright indicator.
tasks.acceptance: Rim interaction allows click-drag date navigation; Right drag = forward in time, left drag = backward; 30-day projection visible as extended wave ribbons; Current date marked with bright indicator on rim

tasks.title: Create Gene Keys Helix: rotating DNA double helix of light strands
tasks.deliverable: Build the Gene Keys artifact as a rotating DNA double helix made of luminous light strands. The helix has 64 positions (one per Gene Key) marked as nodes along the strands. Nodes pulse with different intensities based on activation status.
tasks.acceptance: DNA double helix renders with luminous light strand geometry; 64 Gene Key positions marked as nodes along the helix; Helix rotates slowly (1 revolution per 60 seconds); Activated nodes pulse brighter than dormant ones

tasks.title: Implement Gene Keys Shadow-Gift-Siddhi interaction: touch strand to traverse layers
tasks.deliverable: When user touches a Gene Key node on the helix, it expands to reveal three layers: Shadow (dark red), Gift (gold), and Siddhi (white light). User can swipe between layers to explore the spectrum. Each layer shows its keyword and description.
tasks.acceptance: Touching a node expands it to reveal Shadow/Gift/Siddhi layers; Shadow layer rendered in dark red tonality; Gift layer rendered in gold tonality; Siddhi layer rendered in white light; Swipe gesture traverses between layers

tasks.title: Build Gene Keys birth data to activation mapping (gateway activations from profile)
tasks.deliverable: Create backend logic that maps birth data to Gene Key activations. Calculate the activated Gene Keys from the user's birth profile (similar to Human Design gates). Return the activation sequence, primary Gene Key, and associated programming partners.
tasks.acceptance: Birth data maps to specific Gene Key activations; Returns primary Gene Key (Life's Work); Returns programming partner Gene Keys; Returns full activation profile with Shadow/Gift/Siddhi for each

tasks.title: Create Human Design Bodygraph: 9-center wireframe constellation
tasks.deliverable: Build the Human Design Bodygraph as a 3D wireframe constellation of 9 centers (Head, Ajna, Throat, G, Heart, Sacral, Spleen, Solar Plexus, Root) connected by channels. Centers are geometric shapes, channels are lines. The whole structure floats and gently breathes.
tasks.acceptance: 9 centers rendered as distinct geometric shapes; Channels connect centers as wireframe lines; Bodygraph floats with gentle breathing animation; Centers have distinct shapes matching HD specification

tasks.title: Implement Human Design center highlighting: defined (Gold) vs undefined (Stone Grey)
tasks.deliverable: Based on the user's Human Design chart data, highlight defined centers in Gold with full opacity and undefined centers in Stone Grey with reduced opacity. Defined channels glow gold, undefined channels are dim grey. The visual immediately communicates the user's type.
tasks.acceptance: Defined centers render in Gold with full opacity; Undefined centers render in Stone Grey with reduced opacity; Defined channels glow gold; Undefined channels render as dim grey lines

tasks.title: Build Human Design Strategy/Authority ambient audio per type
tasks.deliverable: Create ambient audio that plays when the user engages with the Bodygraph. Each HD type (Generator, Manifesting Generator, Projector, Manifestor, Reflector) has a distinct tonal quality. The audio subtly reinforces the Strategy/Authority teaching.
tasks.acceptance: Distinct ambient audio for each of the 5 HD types; Audio triggers on engagement with Bodygraph; Tonal quality reflects the type's energy dynamic; Audio fades in/out smoothly on state transitions

tasks.title: Create Chronobiology Clock: biological clock face with circadian zones
tasks.deliverable: Build the Chronobiology Clock as a circular clock face divided into circadian zones (sleep, wake, peak alertness, afternoon dip, evening wind-down). Each zone has a distinct color gradient. A radial hand indicates the current time position.
tasks.acceptance: Circular clock face with circadian zone divisions; Each zone has distinct color gradient (blue=sleep, yellow=peak, etc.); Radial hand indicates current time position; Clock updates in real-time based on device clock

tasks.title: Implement Chronobiology circadian detection from device time + PIP data
tasks.deliverable: Connect the Chronobiology Clock to device time and PIP bio-data. Use device time for base circadian position. Modulate zone boundaries using PIP heart rate variability and alertness indicators. Shift zones based on detected chronotype.
tasks.acceptance: Device time drives base circadian position on clock; PIP HRV data modulates zone boundaries; Alertness indicators shift peak/dip zone positions; Chronotype detection adjusts overall phase shift

tasks.title: Build FastAPI Chronobiology endpoint: POST /api/engines/chronobiology
tasks.deliverable: Create FastAPI endpoint that accepts current time, timezone, chronotype indicators, and optional PIP summary. Returns circadian phase analysis, optimal activity windows, and personalized timing recommendations.
tasks.acceptance: POST /api/engines/chronobiology accepts time, timezone, and chronotype data; Returns circadian phase analysis with current zone identification; Returns optimal activity windows for the next 24 hours; Returns personalized timing recommendations

tasks.title: Implement Tier 2 spatial placement: all 4 engines at radius 10 units from East Wing center
tasks.deliverable: Position all 4 Tier 2 engines (Biorhythm, Gene Keys, Human Design, Chronobiology) at radius 10 units from East Wing center (50,0,0). Engines are evenly spaced at 90-degree intervals, offset 45 degrees from Tier 1 positions to avoid radial alignment.
tasks.acceptance: All 4 Tier 2 engines at radius 10 from (50,0,0); 90-degree spacing between engines; 45-degree offset from Tier 1 angular positions; Each engine faces outward from circle center

tasks.title: Build bio-data gating logic: Tier 2 engines require active webcam/PIP to interact
tasks.deliverable: Implement gating logic that requires active PIP (webcam bio-data pipeline) for Tier 2 engine interaction. Without PIP, Tier 2 engines appear but are shrouded in fog and non-interactive. A visual prompt suggests activating PIP to unlock.
tasks.acceptance: Tier 2 engines require active PIP for interaction; Without PIP, engines are shrouded in fog and non-interactive; Visual prompt appears suggesting PIP activation; On PIP activation, fog clears and interaction enables

tasks.title: Create Tier 2 engine unlock animation: fog thins, glow intensifies, audio cue plays
tasks.deliverable: When PIP activates and Tier 2 engines unlock, play a reveal animation. Fog thins over 2 seconds, engine glow intensifies from 0 to full, and a harmonic audio cue plays. Each engine reveals sequentially with 500ms stagger.
tasks.acceptance: Fog thins over 2 seconds on PIP activation; Engine glow intensifies from 0 to full during reveal; Harmonic audio cue accompanies unlock; Sequential reveal with 500ms stagger between engines

tasks.title: Build Decision Mirror: obsidian tablet artifact with reflective surface shader
tasks.deliverable: Create the Decision Mirror as a large obsidian tablet with a reflective surface shader. The surface uses screen-space reflections or cubemap reflections to create a mirror-like quality. The tablet frame is carved obsidian with gold inlay patterns.
tasks.acceptance: Obsidian tablet mesh with carved frame geometry; Reflective surface shader creates mirror-like quality; Gold inlay patterns visible on tablet frame; Surface reflects nearby engine artifacts

tasks.title: Implement Decision Mirror multi-engine convergence display: overlay layers from active engines
tasks.deliverable: The Decision Mirror displays convergence of readings from all consulted engines. Each engine's reading appears as a semi-transparent layer on the mirror surface. Layers can be individually toggled. Overlapping themes create brighter intersection zones.
tasks.acceptance: Each consulted engine adds a semi-transparent layer to mirror; Layers can be individually toggled on/off; Overlapping themes create brighter intersection zones; At least 2 engine consultations required to activate mirror

tasks.title: Build Decision Mirror convergence score calculation (0-100 based on theme overlap)
tasks.deliverable: Calculate a convergence score (0-100) based on thematic overlap between engine readings displayed on the Decision Mirror. Higher scores indicate stronger agreement between engines. Score displayed as a luminosity level on the mirror border.
tasks.acceptance: Convergence score calculated from 0-100; Score reflects degree of thematic overlap between engine readings; Score displayed as luminosity level on mirror border; Score updates dynamically as new engine readings are added

tasks.title: Implement Decision Mirror layer separation: drag engine layers off surface for comparison
tasks.deliverable: Allow users to drag individual engine layers off the mirror surface for side-by-side comparison. Dragged layers float in 3D space next to the mirror. Lines connect related themes between separated layers. Layers snap back when released near the mirror.
tasks.acceptance: Engine layers can be dragged off mirror surface; Separated layers float in 3D space adjacent to mirror; Connection lines show related themes between layers; Layers snap back to mirror when released nearby

tasks.title: Create Transit Overlay: celestial sphere with natal + transit planetary positions
tasks.deliverable: Build the Transit Overlay as a celestial sphere showing natal planetary positions (fixed, inner ring) and current transit positions (moving, outer ring). Planets are small luminous spheres with astrological glyphs. The sphere is semi-transparent to see through.
tasks.acceptance: Celestial sphere with inner (natal) and outer (transit) rings; Planets rendered as luminous spheres with astrological glyphs; Sphere is semi-transparent for see-through visibility; Transit positions update based on current date

tasks.title: Build Transit time scrub: drag outer ring to change date, planetary positions update
tasks.deliverable: Add time scrubbing to the Transit Overlay. Dragging the outer ring changes the date, causing transit planets to move to their positions for that date. Speed of scrub proportional to drag velocity. Date indicator updates in real-time during scrub.
tasks.acceptance: Dragging outer ring changes transit date; Transit planets animate to new positions during scrub; Scrub speed proportional to drag velocity; Date indicator updates in real-time

tasks.title: Implement Transit aspect highlighting: Gold=harmonious, Terracotta=challenging, Grey=neutral lines
tasks.deliverable: Draw aspect lines between natal and transit planets. Harmonious aspects (trine, sextile) in Gold, challenging aspects (square, opposition) in Terracotta, neutral (conjunction, semi-sextile) in Grey. Lines pulse intensity based on aspect exactness (tighter = brighter).
tasks.acceptance: Gold lines for trines and sextiles; Terracotta lines for squares and oppositions; Grey lines for conjunctions and semi-sextiles; Line pulse intensity proportional to aspect exactness

tasks.title: Build FastAPI Transit calculation endpoint: POST /api/engines/transit
tasks.deliverable: Create FastAPI endpoint that accepts natal chart data and target date. Calculates transit planetary positions using ephemeris, computes aspects between natal and transit planets, and returns aspect interpretations with timing windows.
tasks.acceptance: POST /api/engines/transit accepts natal data and target date; Calculates transit planetary positions via ephemeris; Computes all aspects between natal and transit planets; Returns aspect interpretations with timing windows

tasks.title: Create Somatic Canticle Index: bio-gated content release artifact
tasks.deliverable: Build the Somatic Canticle Index as a scroll-like artifact that unfurls based on bio-data state. Content (canticles / somatic practices) is locked behind bio-metric gates. Each gate requires a specific physiological state (calm, focused, energized) to open.
tasks.acceptance: Scroll-like artifact mesh with unfurling animation; Content sections locked behind bio-metric gates; Gates require specific physiological states to open; Visual indicators show current gate readiness

tasks.title: Build FastAPI Somatic Canticle endpoint: POST /api/engines/somatic-canticle
tasks.deliverable: Create FastAPI endpoint that accepts bio-data summary (HRV, coherence, affect) and returns appropriate somatic practices and canticle content. Content is tiered by bio-state achievement. Returns personalized practice recommendations.
tasks.acceptance: POST /api/engines/somatic-canticle accepts bio-data summary; Returns somatic practices tiered by bio-state achievement; Returns personalized practice recommendations; Content gating validated server-side

tasks.title: Implement Tier 3 spatial placement: Decision Mirror, Transit, Somatic at radius 15 from East center
tasks.deliverable: Position all 3 Tier 3 engines (Decision Mirror, Transit Overlay, Somatic Canticle Index) at radius 15 units from East Wing center (50,0,0). Engines spaced at 120-degree intervals, offset from Tier 1 and Tier 2 angular positions.
tasks.acceptance: All 3 Tier 3 engines at radius 15 from (50,0,0); 120-degree spacing between engines; Angular offset from Tier 1 and Tier 2 positions; Each engine faces outward from circle center

tasks.title: Build Human Design gate-to-Gene Key cross-reference interaction
tasks.deliverable: Implement cross-referencing between Human Design gates and Gene Keys. When a user taps a gate on the Bodygraph, the corresponding Gene Key node on the Helix highlights and vice versa. A connection line bridges the two artifacts temporarily.
tasks.acceptance: Tapping HD gate highlights corresponding Gene Key node; Tapping Gene Key node highlights corresponding HD gate; Temporary connection line bridges the two artifacts; Cross-reference uses standard HD gate-to-GK mapping

tasks.title: Implement Transit-to-Vimshottari cross-reference: tapping aspect highlights Dasha period
tasks.deliverable: Cross-reference Transit aspects with Vimshottari Dasha periods. When a transit aspect is tapped, highlight the corresponding Dasha period on the Vimshottari Clock that governs the same time window. Show temporal overlap visually.
tasks.acceptance: Tapping a transit aspect highlights corresponding Dasha period; Vimshottari Clock ring rotates to show relevant period; Temporal overlap displayed visually between the two systems; Cross-reference connection line between artifacts

tasks.title: Create FastAPI Human Design endpoint: POST /api/engines/human-design
tasks.deliverable: Create FastAPI endpoint that accepts birth data and calculates the full Human Design chart. Returns type, strategy, authority, profile, defined/undefined centers, active channels, and gate activations with interpretations.
tasks.acceptance: POST /api/engines/human-design accepts birth date, time, and location; Returns type, strategy, authority, and profile; Returns defined/undefined center map; Returns active channels and gate activations with interpretations

tasks.title: Build FastAPI Gene Keys endpoint: POST /api/engines/gene-keys
